title: bazis-design/1: spec/design/theme.yaml
description: The design of the frontend: the preset of its shell and its options. The tokens of spec/design/tokens.json must define every token that the preset requires.

preset.description: workspace: the shell of a working application (a dense layout for daily work); portal: a public shell (a lighter layout with headings).

list_card.description: split: the list and the card side by side; pages: the card replaces the list.

forms.description: Forms in a dialog or on a page.
